rationale: Addresses cluster [validate_failed::workflow-section] (t05-collection): provenance field entirely missing from produced pack. By elevating provenance to a core Data Pack rule alongside the existing four, the agent internalizes provenance as a fundamental, non-negotiable requirement before it even enters the workflow steps, rather than treating it as an optional afterthought that validation will catch.
expected_effect: The agent will treat provenance stamping as a first-class requirement on par with ID-only references and single-source-of-truth. When writing extraction configs or reviewing output packs, it will verify provenance is present on every record rather than omitting it and relying on validation to flag the omission.
regression_risk: Very low — adds one new rule (rule 4) and renumbers the existing rule 4 to rule 5. All existing rules, their wording, and their ordering relative to each other are preserved unchanged. Passing tasks (t01-t04) do not depend on the rule count or numbering.
